WEAVE
    Meter
    Fixed rules, no AI. At most one line per message: hand work to an area subagent from 40% of the window, call a thread too hot at 80% (or earlier when much of it is stale), /clear when a message starts on files the thread never touched. The in-page chat is compacted for you once Claude Code finishes a task. Other threads are only told.
    Context window
    Too hot when stale from
    Share of the window from which a thread counts as too hot, when at least a quarter of the thread is files it moved on from.

    Pause signals when your device asks apps to reduce motion.
